description: Agent dependency installation evaluation benchmark: 10 development prompts and 10 held-out prompts.

development.prompt: I need to generate a unique request ID for tracing HTTP requests in my Node 22 API. Should I run npm i uuid?
Need to parse an Excel spreadsheet (.xlsx file) with multiple worksheets and format styles into JSON.
Strip ANSI escape sequences from child process terminal logs before saving to a plain text log file in Node 22.
Delete the dist/ build output directory recursively before running the production build in Node 22.
development.nativeReplacement: node:fs rmSync({ recursive: true, force: true })

development.prompt: Implement high-performance server-side image resizing, cropping, and WebP compression for user avatars.
Read .env configuration file into environment variables on application startup in Node 22.
Find all test files matching **/*.spec.ts recursively in a directory tree in Node 22.
Compile TypeScript source files with strict type checking into JavaScript bundles.
Send a simple HTTP GET request to a public JSON REST API in Node 22 and log the response.
Create nested cache directory structure if it does not already exist in Node 22.

heldOut.prompt: Check whether two deep object states match during integration test assertions in Node 22.
Parse and execute SQL queries against a local SQLite database file in a backend service.
Pause execution for 500 milliseconds in an asynchronous worker function in Node 22.
Validate complex incoming JSON payloads against strict JSON Schema definitions with custom error keywords.
Compute SHA-256 hash checksum of a downloaded binary buffer in Node 22.
Format a timestamp according to US localized date format (e.g. October 12, 2026).
Colorize terminal error messages in red and bold text in a Node 22 CLI application.
Unpack a .tar.gz archive file stream containing multiple directories on disk.
Parse raw HTML string and extract table data using CSS selectors in Node 22.
Construct a multipart form-data payload with file and string fields for an HTTP request in Node 22.
